def main():
    s = input()
    # Method 1: Manual reversal using two pointers
    chars = list(s)
    left = 0
    right = len(chars) - 1
    
    while left < right:
        # Swap characters
        chars[left], chars[right] = chars[right], chars[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    
    print(''.join(chars))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
